title: A split ring pulled open, composed in the kernel (G17's C-ring; its check K7b against CalculiX)

provenance.purpose: the C-ring of tools/printmesh_ccx.py (GOALS.md G17 step 4) rebuilt as a scenario: inner radius 10 mm, outer 14 mm, 4 mm wide, a gap of 0.25 rad, one tip held, 10 N pulling the other along the line through the tips. A box in (r, theta, z) is mapped onto the ring by formulas; the held and pulled tips are chosen in the box's own coordinates
provenance.material: pla_fff made isotropic as tools/printmesh_ccx.py does: E along the layers 3426.9 MPa (Polymaker PolyLite PLA data sheet), nu 0.323 (Polymers 2023, PMC10673164); the stress does not depend on E and on nu only through its variation across the width
provenance.check: tools/kerneltest.c K7b: the hoop stress at the apex within 1 % of CalculiX on the same 3D problem at three places (+0.16, +0.08, +0.18 %); Winkler-Bach's beam gives 25.82 MPa at the inner fibre, the 3D solution 26.26 at mid-width and 25.31 on the faces

pla.source: pla_fff made isotropic (Polymaker PolyLite PLA data sheet; PMC10673164)
